title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
All positions in this record are paper signals. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The live record is a running account of engine state, and a single trade does not say anything about a strategy.

## What the record contains

The record covers htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006. htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. The phrase "average null net per trade" is reported as recorded; it is not converted into another number here. trend-daily-v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and trend-daily-v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. Both trend engines show the Bitcoin market filter off, 0 positions open on paper, and closed-trade averages of -13.22% and -13.34% net per trade. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-11T02:54:41.241Z. A live record begins on a stated date, and the snapshot time is part of the record because the state changes as new closes arrive.

## The first live signal and the ATOM trade

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule in the record is visible as a sequence: an entry at 2.066, then an exit triggered by a close below the 10-day low, with the measured outcome of -17.9% after costs. The measurement includes the 30 bps round trip, so the -17.9% is after that cost. The recorded price moved from 2.066 to 1.703. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, and no exit is recorded for it. The ATOM result is a single closed trade, and the NEAR position is an open trade; neither is a large sample. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. A single trade, whether open or closed, does not establish how the strategy behaves.

## Open positions and closed trades

The live snapshot shows 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006. The record also lists the NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 as open since. Both statements are reported as they appear. Closed trades so far are 4 for htf-rsi-v007, 6 for trend-daily-v005, and 7 for trend-daily-v006. Their measured averages are null net per trade, -13.22% net per trade, and -13.34% net per trade. The closed-trade averages are net per trade, as recorded. With 4, 6, and 7 closed trades, these averages describe what happened in that short record. They are not a forecast and do not say what the next trade will do.

## Market filter and breakout distances

For trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006, the Bitcoin market filter is off. With the filter off and 0 positions open on paper, the record shows no active trend entries for those engines. The filter being off is a state, not a prediction. The symbols closest to their 20-day breakout are TRXUSDT at 9.82% below its high, BNBUSDT at 10.43% below its high, and UNIUSDT at 12.53% below its high. The breakout distances are percentages below the recorded high. A smaller percentage means a symbol is closer to that high; TRXUSDT at 9.82% is closer than UNIUSDT at 12.53%. They are not recommendations, price targets, or signals to act.

## Where the numbers are checked

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The performance page, signal log, and channel status are separate views of the same record. Checking them together is a way to verify that the numbers match, not a way to select a trade. The record updates continuously, so the state described here is the state read at 2026-11-11T02:54:41.241Z. No forecast is made here because the record is a snapshot of state, not a prediction. Because every position in the record is paper, the measurements describe simulated outcomes rather than realized trading results.
